articles.title: Crypto catches its breath as bitcoin settles into a holding pattern amid July rally
articles.snippet: BTC is rangebound between $64,000 and $66,800 after a 13% recovery from July's lows, with macro markets offering little direction and WLFI the session's surprise standout at +12%.

articles.title: Bitcoin wilts as oil and rates rise. Clarity Act odds tumble to 38%
articles.snippet: Geopolitical risks, rising rates, and fresh regulatory setbacks send crypto lower as key Democrats demand stronger safeguards in the market structure bill.

articles.title: Google Ships New Gemini Flash Models, But Pro Is Still Missing
articles.snippet: As Gemini 3.5 Pro stalls in testing limbo, Google ships 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and a restricted cybersecurity model—and quietly teases Gemini 4.
